_comment: Non-regression ratchet for .github/workflows/coverage.yml: CI fails when line coverage lands more than tolerance_pct below its baseline. Raise a baseline in the same PR that improves coverage; lowering one is permitted but is then a deliberate, reviewable act. rust_lines_pct is 0 (unarmed) until the first Rust coverage run reports a real number - putting a figure here that nobody has measured is the exact habit this ratchet exists to break.
